Six ways Analytics could work

Six concept directions for the Analytics page, each a working front-end prototype on sample data from The Orchard, Mara & Finn's wedding, a student group and a small agency. Each one answers how the work is going, for someone who has never read a chart for work.

Tap any screenshot to see it full size. Mark the ones you like with Favourite, then copy your picks. To try one live, run the review dev server and open the path shown on its card. These went straight from build to gallery, with no critique round.

Analytics

How the work is going, answered in five seconds, with the numbers there for whoever wants to dig in.

Analytics 1

The Friday letter

Analytics as a short, warm letter from a good project manager, written fresh each Friday, with word-sized charts set into the sentences and a margin that lights up the exact bar a phrase refers to.

Signature momentThe analytics page literally reads like a letter, with tiny charts living inside the sentences and a margin that lights up the exact bar a phrase refers to.

/app/concepts/analytics/1
Analytics 2

Will we make it

One question answered with one picture: a landing forecast of when the remaining work finishes against the big date, and plain-English levers that visibly slide it.

Signature momentThe runway chart where the forecast fan lands on or past the wedding day, and flipping a plain-English lever visibly slides the landing date.

Claude’s pick It answers the question every planner actually has, will we make it, in one sentence at the top, and the chart and switches underneath show what would change the answer.

/app/concepts/analytics/2
Analytics 3

Who needs a hand

Each person's coming weeks stack up as tiles against their own usual pace, so anyone can see whose pile spills over and drag work to someone with room.

Signature momentShelves of task tiles per person with a dashed line at each person's own usual pace, so overload is visible as a pile spilling over the line, and dragging a tile fixes it.

/app/concepts/analytics/3
Analytics 4

Project replay

Replay the whole Project day by day on a simple board, with the moments that changed its course pinned to the timeline, so you can watch how it got here instead of reading about it.

Signature momentPressing play and watching the Project's tasks flow across the board over 14 weeks, with the story moments pinned to the scrubber like chapters.

/app/concepts/analytics/4
Analytics 5

Ask a question

A question-first page where you pick or type what you want to know and get back one plain sentence and the one chart that proves it, chained into a thread of follow-ups you can pin.

Signature momentTyping a plain question and seeing the card lift into a single bold sentence with exactly one chart beneath it, then chaining follow-ups like a conversation.

/app/concepts/analytics/5
Analytics 6

All projects wall

A calm wall of identical small multiples puts every Project side by side on the same scales, with one crosshair that lights the same week on all of them, for the owner who wants to compare everything.

Signature momentEvery Project on one wall with identical small multiples on the same scale, and a linked crosshair that lights the same week across all of them.
